This is why the air can look perfectly clear even when $CO_2$ concentrations are high.

To broaden the scope, consider **Methane ($CH_4$)**. It is another carbon-based greenhouse gas that is also invisible to the naked eye but is roughly 80 times more potent at trapping heat than $CO_2$ over a 20-year period. We rely on infrared cameras, rather than human vision, to detect these "invisible" leaks in industrial infrastructure.
